name: Sketch
pitch: For explainer talks that build an idea step by step, as if the speaker were drawing it on a whiteboard in front of you.

illustration.medium: flat vector styled as a hand-drawn notebook sketch on cream paper
illustration.line: 3 to 4px wobbly hand-drawn strokes, slightly irregular, like a felt-tip pen
illustration.shapes: loose, imperfect circles and rectangles (irregular border-radius), doodle-like annotations
illustration.texture: faint paper grain, no digital smoothness
illustration.palette_use: cream background dominant, near-black ink, one soft yellow highlighter fill used behind key text or shapes, occasional red-pen accent for a correction mark
illustration.avoid: perfectly straight lines, gradients, glossy 3D, digital UI chrome
